subject: deploying a packrat project to shinyapps

messages.author: 4bb05a63182265dd
messages.subject: deploying a packrat project to shinyapps
parts:
What is the proper way to deploy a packrat project to shinyapps.io? Is there anything unique that needs to be done with a packrat project to avoid uploading every associated library.

James

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] deploying a packrat project to shinyapps
parts:
Packrat projects are not supported. However, along as your packages are sourced from CRAN or GibHub, they will be automatically detected and installed when you deploy your application. To there is no need to manually upload or install packages.

-Andy

What is the proper way to deploy a packrat project to shinyapps.io? Is there anything unique that needs to be done with a packrat project to avoid uploading every associated library.

James
